guard: a dry run plans and prints without writing the operator-global seed store, manifest or npm prefix, whether it goes on to render a plan or to reject the invocation; `agent-bearer`, the per-refresh machine helper, passes the same gate without reconciling (no generation refusal, no store write)
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/dry-run-no-seed.smoke.ts
why: The boot gate ran before command lookup, flag parsing and the command body, so `down --preserve-state --dry-run` rewrote the machine-wide seed store and only then printed the usage refusal (#1620). A suite asserting only the refusal text would stay green with the defect live, because the exit code and the error line are identical either way.

The mutation removes only the dry-run skip, leaving every other skip in place, so a green run after it would mean the suite observes the refusal rather than the writes. The suite drives the BUILT binary, so each cell rebuilds and the restore rebuilds back.

mutations.name: let a dry run fall through to the boot-gate seed reconcile
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/dry-run-no-seed.smoke.ts
mutations.note: Compile-clean: the surrounding --help and update skips stay live, so only the dry-run promise regresses. Restores the exact incident: the store is migrated, then the invocation is refused.
